title: Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: Simple Style Guide for Elements
text:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: Simple Style Guide for Elements
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034719
In this article, the styling Classes of the Pricing Page menu will be outlined:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180594445/original/sTrF1QK1rCC71w2wbDxdsOknHS3zyni_Cg.png?1781714510 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180594490/original/EcIUCLqijNMvoDjq6Y4-zBHBO6_4o1_NOw.png?1781714532 | alt: ]
The Pricing Page modules consists of:
1. Title
2. Price
3. Sub-Price
4. Features
5. Checkout Button
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12073836098/original/NSYyUkfiLZp_Pt5D67dyyS3CZtWZI82YzA.png?1581436058 | alt: ]

## Button
To create a button, we recommend using the class " btn btn-success btn-lg vmargin bold ".
